match: This PEP documents the semantics and conventions
The aim of this PEP is to standardize
A docstring is a string literal that occurs as the first statement
One-liners are for really obvious cases. They should really fit on one line
The docstring for a module should generally list the classes
use the Emacs convention of mentioning the arguments
Docstring processing tools will strip a uniform amount of indentation
The docstring in this example contains two newline characters
